Create conversational ad creative that promotes Skechers Slip-Ins to
different audiences. The creative should highlight the convenience and ease
of wearing Slip-Ins.
Key Idea
Messaging should feel relevant to the user’s daily routine, changing based
on time of day or day of week.
Example:
● Parents (Weekday AM): School drop-off
● Parents (Weekday PM): School pick-up
● Weekends: Kids’ sports activities orfamily outings
The message should reflect these moments so the product feels useful for
that specific situation.

Conversation Buttons
Include three product category options:
● Men’s
● Women’s
● Kids

What the Designer Should Show
The creative should demonstrate:
1. Opening message tailored to a moment (e.g. schoolrun).
2. Conversation buttons (Men / Women / Kids).
3. Product imagery and messaging highlighting Slip-Ins convenience.
4. A clear mobile conversational flow.

Key Product Message
Focus on:
● Easy to slip on
● Hands-free convenience
● Comfort for busy lifestyles
